projects.name: SDDOT STIP 2027 (Approved) - Construction Reconstruction
projects.notes: One layer per improvement category of the approved STIP map; the layer itself is the work type. Most relevant for land acquisition (grading, reconstruction). No status field: everything here is programmed, not yet built. FiscalYear and ConstructionYear are text years; LettingDate is often null. EstCost is dollars. Other fields: HwyNbr, BegMRMNbr/EndMRMNbr (mile markers), SegmentLen, FundCat1-5, ProjectList (control number + project number), ProjectManager, ReadyDate. MapCategory sample value 'Con/Recon'. Coordinates are a South Dakota projected system (ask for outSR=4326). ConstructionYear values on this layer: '2027', '2027 & 2028', '2027 - 2029', '2028', '2028 & 2029', '2029', '2029 & 2030', '2030', '2030 & 2031'.

parcels_counties.notes: Rapid City / Pennington County open data tax parcels. summary: Projects work well: SDDOT's approved STIP map service gives planned projects as lines per category with cost, year and county. No statewide owner parcels. Pennington (Rapid City) is verified and in use. Checked 2026-11-22: Codington, Beadle and Roberts (First District) and Davison, Hughes, Butte and Yankton (Planning and Development District III) and the City of Brookings answer with owner names but are held on terms; Minnehaha, Sioux Falls and Lawrence servers timed out and Lincoln sits behind a bot check.
parcels_statewide_reason: No free statewide parcel layer with owner names was found on the state servers checked (sdgis.sd.gov hosted services, the State of South Dakota ArcGIS Online organisation); parcels are published county by county.
